178608e876.q: What is Trellis and how does it consolidate short-term rental property management tools?
178608e876.a: Trellis consolidates all fragmented property management tools and external systems like Slack, WhatsApp, and call centers into one place, providing AI agents with full business context so they can automate end-to-end workflows from guest issues to task dispatching to closing the loop. The platform is built AI-native from the ground up, meaning agents can fully operate it, whereas legacy PMSs like Guesty and HostAway were built for humans first and cannot innovate at the same pace.

3986def8e3.q: How does Trellis differ from general-purpose AI agents like Instinct or Claude for property management?
3986def8e3.a: General-purpose AI agents like Instinct are not built specifically for short-term rentals and often fail to retrieve correct property data because they lack domain expertise and integration with channel managers and PMSs. Trellis was built for this technology first, starting with agents as the core design principle, whereas legacy tools built before 2025 were designed for humans and cannot connect information across stakeholders like guests, cleaners, and operators the way Trellis agents can.

be720e013f.q: What technology stack should tech-savvy property managers build instead of using traditional PMSs?
be720e013f.a: Tech-savvy property managers can either choose a PMS with the best API documentation like Guesty, or build their own operating system by connecting directly to a channel manager like Chanex, Actual, or Rentals United. Saigon is seeing more people building their own systems in-house using Claude and Codex rather than relying on traditional PMSs, because building is becoming easier and cheaper.

1c2d6d23ba.q: How are AI agents disrupting the OTA intermediation in short-term rental direct bookings?
1c2d6d23ba.a: AI agents like Instruct and Muse can compare prices across Airbnb and direct bookings, automatically booking direct when it is 20% cheaper, which erodes the OTAs' moat. This represents a huge opportunity for direct booking tool vendors, though most property managers still depend on OTAs because of their reach, but this dependency is weakening as AI agents disintermediate the booking process.
